Classics that left behind a considerable impression:

  1. Great Expectation by Charles Dickens
  2. Emma by Jane Austen
  3. Les Miserables by Victor Hugo
  4. Tess of the D’Urbervilles by Thomas Hardy
  5. Jane Eyre by Charlotte Brontë
  6. Rebecca by Daphne du Maurier
  7. Little Women by Louisa May Alcott
  8. The Princess Bride by William Goldman
  9. A Farewell to Arms by Ernest Hemingway
  10. Anne of Green Gables by L. M. Montgomery
  11. Don Quixote by Cervantes
  12. War and Peace by Leo Tolstoy
  13. Anna Karenina by Leo Tolstoy
  14. The Count of Monte Cristo by Alexandre Dumas
  15. Crime and Punishment by Fyodor Dostoevsky
